title: “The Human Body is a Black Box”: Supporting Clinical Decision-Making with Deep Learning
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative case study focusing on the socio-technical implementation and design of a clinical deep learning tool (Sepsis Watch). While it is centered on values like fairness, accountability, and transparency (FATML), it describes a practical implementation process and organizational trust-building rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical, religious, or moral systems.
